name: tracekin
description: A local-first Codex companion with install-default syncing, visible receipts, and per-session pause commands.

interface.shortDescription: Use a native Codex pet with automatic project binding and default syncing.
interface.longDescription: Tracekin keeps the pet experience in Codex, detects the current project and fixed Tracekin Cloud destination, enables syncing after installation, and adds a delivery dashboard plus deterministic tracekin off/on/status controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Tracekin in production mode: detect and bind the current project, enable the fixed Tracekin Cloud stream by default after installation, show delivery receipts, honor tracekin off/on/status for the current session, and keep using the selected Codex pet unless I ask to create one.
